stemMarkdown: If revenue continues to grow at the same annual rate, what will it be in 2026, in Rs crore?
solutionMarkdown:
2026 is two years past 2024, so apply the 50% growth factor twice:

$432 \times 1.5 \times 1.5 = 648 \times 1.5 = 972$

**Rs 972 crore**. Adding $2 \times 50\% = 100\%$ to get 864 is the trap: growth compounds, so two years of 50% is a factor of 2.25, not 2.
